description: The bar chart titled “QA-2” visually compares the performance of two models — one unnamed (represented by a gray label) and “RedWhale (our)” — across three categories of answer quality: “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and “Incorrect,” as indicated by the legend at the bottom. The horizontal axis represents percentage values, though no explicit axis label or scale ticks are shown; the values are directly labeled on each segment of the stacked bars. For the unnamed model, the stacked bar shows 92.9% Correct (dark purple), 2.9% Partially Correct (medium blue), and 4.3% Incorrect (light blue). For RedWhale (our), the corresponding values are 95.7% Correct, 1.4% Partially Correct, and 2.9% Incorrect. The chart illustrates that RedWhale outperforms the unnamed model in Correct answers and has lower rates of Partially Correct and Incorrect responses, suggesting improved accuracy on the QA-2 benchmark. The bars are horizontally oriented, with each model’s performance shown as a single stacked bar, and the categories are consistently color-coded across both bars. No gridlines or numerical axis are present, and the chart focuses on direct value comparison through labeled segments.
